marks.gloss_en: הילכך -- since only one whose impurity issues from his body is barred, and only from eating, a niddah may separate the challa and a [pure] minor priest eats it
Ravina: therefore a niddah separates challa [outside the Land] and a minor priest eats it
how so? an Israelite separated teruma from his pile, and another Israelite said to him: here is this sela, give it to my daughter's son, a priest -- permitted
teruma has bodily sanctity; since it cannot be redeemed, one will not come to err in it
these [the priestly gifts], since they are sanctity of value, one would err in them -- [thinking] their sanctity was redeemed onto the four zuz -- and come to treat them as non-sacred
Rava: teruma of outside the Land carries no [issue] of the priest who assists at the threshing floor
Shmuel: teruma of outside the Land is nullified in a majority
Rav Huna b. Rav Yehoshua, when teruma wine came his way, poured two jugs of non-sacred and one of teruma and took out one; from then on, he poured one and took out one
and Shmuel said: teruma of outside the Land -- one eats as he goes and separates afterwards
and Shmuel said: teruma of outside the Land is forbidden only to one whose impurity issues from his body
